stops.name: Landing Site / Base
stops.desc: Primary habitat and landing zone located on flat, safe crater plains.

stops.name: Hollow
stops.desc: Sedimentary depression trapping wind-blown eolian grains and fine dust; primary target to sample active surface transport and shallow volatiles.

stops.name: Layered outcrop
stops.desc: Exposed stratigraphic sequence of rhythmically bedded lacustrine mudstones; vital for deciphering ancient aqueous depositional history.

stops.name: Boxwork ridge base
stops.desc: Fractured, mineralized veins formed by deep groundwater circulation through Gale Crater bedrock; critical target for past subsurface habitability.

15.reason: No safe route found for 15° threshold. (Leg 1: Base → Hollow blocked by terrain steeper than 15° (max 14.2°).)

10.reason: No safe route found for 10° threshold. (Leg 1: Base → Hollow blocked by terrain steeper than 10° (max 52.1°).)
